title: Repeat Failed Visits and the Ridgeline Installation Services Trip Charge
content:
How often the customer side has caused a failed visit on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract sets the occurrence share of the failed-visit trip charge.

**Clause.** Occurrence share of the failed-visit trip charge: the occurrences are every visit on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready; a contract with exactly one such visit takes the first-occurrence share of 0.5, a contract with at least the repeat-occurrence count of 3 such visits takes the repeat-occurrence multiple of 1.5, and any other contract takes an occurrence share of 1.

The failed-visit trip charge is multiplied by the occurrence share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the failed-visit trip charge is rounded, the failed-visit trip charge being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Counting

Customer-absent visits and site-not-ready visits are counted together, across every visit recorded on the contract. Visits the installer missed, and visits completed as scheduled, are not counted.

| Customer-absent or site-not-ready visits on the contract | Occurrence share |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0.5 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 1.5 |
| 4 or more | 1.5 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical trip charge of 149.00 before the share)

| Visit record of the contract | Count | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| one site-not-ready visit | 1 | 0.5 | 74.50 |
| one customer-absent and one site-not-ready visit | 2 | 1 | 149.00 |
| two customer-absent visits and one site-not-ready visit | 3 | 1.5 | 223.50 |
